### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, A38 occurred in all 200 traces and was followed by A23 exactly two positions later in all of them, with one activity in between; that in-between activity was one of five mutually exclusive alternatives (they never appeared together in one trace), and each of the five led on only to A23. Of A38's outgoing transitions, about 25 in 100 went to A21, 22 to A14, 20 to A22, 18 to A15 and 17 to A20. [DIR006, LAG001, DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL010, REL011, REL012, REL015, REL016, REL019]
- In the later window, none of the five alternatives — A14, A15, A20, A21, A22 — was observed: each had run in roughly 17–25 in 100 traces before (33–49 of 200 traces) but in 0 of 200 after. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005]
- A38 now leads directly to A23: the A38→A23 distance is one step in every later trace instead of two. A23 itself still occurs in every trace and sits only slightly earlier (median position about 0.38 to 0.36 of the trace). [LAG001, POS006]
- Co-occurrences with the removed activities vanished: A14 and A21 each co-occurred with A23 in about 22–25 in 100 earlier traces (always before A23), and with A38 (A38 first) and with A39; none of this remains in the later window. [REL005, REL020, REL006, REL021, REL007, REL022]
- A41 and A42 became more frequent, each running in about 53 in 100 traces before and about 67 in 100 after, and they no longer co-occur with any of the five removed activities (about 9–13 in 100 traces before, none after). [REL008, REL013, REL017, REL023, REL025, REL009, REL014, REL018, REL024, REL026]
- The elapsed time between consecutive completion events rose for all four monitored pairs into A28 — (A16, A28), (A17, A28), (A18, A28), (A19, A28) — from about 1.0 hour to about 2.1 hours (medians about 1.0 to about 2.1 hours), on 46–53 intervals per pair and window. [TWAIT001, TWAIT002, TWAIT003, TWAIT004]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that the five-way alternative step between A38 and A23 is no longer executed in the later window: previously every case ran A38, then exactly one of A14, A15, A20, A21 or A22, then A23, whereas now A38 leads directly to A23 and none of the five appears in 200 later traces. The change is shown directly by the successor change at A38 and by the A38→A23 distance shrinking from two steps to one in every trace, and it is consistent across the participation, position and relation items for the five activities and their downstream partners. [DIR006, LAG001, OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005, REL005, REL006, REL020, REL021]

A chance explanation is implausible: 44 control-flow items qualified against roughly 0.54 expected for an unchanged process, and 4 time items against about 0.01, and each of the five activities had 33–49 supporting traces before, so their joint disappearance is not a sampling effect. An important competing explanation remains: the evidence cannot distinguish the block having been removed from it still existing but not being taken in any later trace, since zero participation only shows the activities were not observed. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005, DIR006]

Other differences: A41 and A42 now run in about two thirds of traces, up from about half, and no longer appear alongside the five removed activities. [REL008, REL009, REL013, REL014, REL017, REL018, REL023, REL024, REL025, REL026]

The elapsed time between consecutive completion events into A28 (from A16, A17, A18 or A19) roughly doubled, from about 1 hour to about 2.1 hours; this is a timing change in its own right, and the evidence provides no link between it and the structural change above. [TWAIT001, TWAIT002, TWAIT003, TWAIT004]
